text.en:
Pursuant to Section 5 of RA No. 7656, the percentage of net
earnings to be declared and remitted by the PSALM as dividends to the National
Government is adiusted from at least fifty percent (50%) of their annual net earnings
to 3.3030407%, or an estimated amount of P2.11 Billion, for calendar years 2004,
THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

The adjusted dividend rate set forth in Section 1 of this Order is
only applicable to the net earnings of the PSALM for the years stated above.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 25th day of
Our Lord, Two Thousand and Eighteen.
in the vear of
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary
